digitCount.description: Optional minimum number of digits within the passcode.

symbolCount.description: Optional minimum number of symbols within the passcode.

lowerCaseCount.description: Optional minimum number of lower case characters within the passcode.

upperCaseCount.description: Optional minimum number of upper case characters within the passcode.

characterVariety.description: Optional minimum number of different classes of character that the passcode must contain, where the classes are symbols, digits, upper case and lower case.

passcodeHistory.description: Optional passcode history. A submitted passcode is checked against a configurable number of previously submitted passcodes to see if it matches.

requiredRegExes.description: Optional list of required regular expressions, all of which must be matched for the passcode to be accepted as valid.

allowedRegExes.description: Optional list of allowed regular expressions, at least one of which must be matched for the passcode to be accepted as valid.

disallowedRegExes.description: Optional list of disallowed regular expressions, none of which must be matched for the passcode to be accepted as valid.

algorithmVariant.description: The variant of the algorithm used as a user friendly name for a set of algorithm parameters.

passcodeValidityDuration.description: Optional passcode validity duration. The value is a duration string. If not supplied the passcode has no expiration date associated with it and therefore does not expire.

sessionDuration.description: Session lifetime. The value is a duration string. Defaults to 5 minutes.

auditLevel.description: Defines the level of auditing, none, fail-only or always. Defaults to NONE.

auditDuration.default: 30 days or whatever number is configured as `default.max.audit.retention.days`
auditDuration.description: How long to store the audit file. The value is a duration string.

PasscodeRegex.description: A regular expression matched against a passcode.

error.description: An error which will be displayed if the regex check fails.

SRPAlgorithmParameters.description: Parameters for the Secure Remote Passcode (SRP) passcode algorithm.

prime.description: The safe prime to use. **IT IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO USE `primeBitLen` INSTEAD WHICH USES THE SAFE PRIME VALUES DEFINED IN RFC 5054 APPENDIX A**. If both `prime` and `primeBitLen` are supplied, `prime` takes precedence.

primeBitLen.description:
The bit length of the safe prime (n) to use, as defined in RFC 5054 Appendix A. Values:
- 1536
- 2048
- 3072
- 4096
- 6144
- 8192

saltByteLen.description: The length of the salt in bytes.

hashAlgorithm.description:
The hash algorithm. Values:
- SHA-256
- SHA-384
- SHA-512
